title: Conformance fixture: athlete state
description: An athlete's current recorded values, as consumed by resolve() (spec/semantics/resolution.md) and produced by progress() (spec/semantics/progression.md). Two independent lookup tables: `bindings` for dotted `state`/`stats` paths (e.g. tm.squat.weight), `catalogFields` for per-exercise history (e.g. $BarbellBackSquat.e1rm). A path/field with no entry is unset — resolve() must fall back per spec/semantics/parameters.md.
